actual_manual_comparison: Actually compared the original and complete unchanged raw output, paired sheet and white/cyan composites. Blue-gray soft cap with red star and dark visor, cap-covered hair/brows, serious closed-mouth face and near-front leftward pose retained; plain blue-gray military folded collar and center button remain, without invented heavy facial hair or large accessories. Compact round mascot head and short broad neck fit the widened original collar without clipping, long pillar neck or white belly at neckline. The dark frame, shaded internal backing and aged lower-right paper are retained; exterior transparency is intentional. Whole-image alpha extrema are [0, 255]. Finite interior sampling is numerical support only, not a claim of globally255 interiors. Composites show no material internal holes. Source remains Chinese CCP related archive-only, prohibited from final mod payload; its art gap is not a release blocker. Art approval only; native derivatives and live-game acceptance are separate.
